skill.ton618.ton_618.last_light.desc: To unlock: set TON618's Scale to ∞ (no limit) and use it, so it devours the world; then cast Last Light in the dark. Let time go: the stars burn out, the eras pass, and after a googol of years TON618 has evaporated away by Hawking radiation. Its last light brings the world back, on a new morning, for everyone in the dark.

skill.ton618.ton_618.quasar_jets.desc: With SS-21 Quasar installed. At night, look at one of the named stars and cast to lock it; then aim at the ground and cast again. A star engine pushes the star across the universe into TON618, which devours it and blazes as a quasar: night turns to day, its jet comes in from the horizon carrying what it touches, and a radio lobe bursts where it lands, leaving frozen light. The star's type sets the size. It is missing from the sky for a few nights.
From TON 618 Addition, with SS-21 Quasar installed. At night, look at one of the named stars and cast to lock it; then aim at the ground and cast again. A star engine pushes the star into TON618, which devours it and blazes as a quasar: night turns to day, its jet comes in from the horizon carrying what it touches, and a radio lobe bursts where it lands, leaving frozen light. The star's type sets the size.
